title: Who is Jesus Christ
short_answer: Jesus Christ is the Son of God and the Savior of the world who came to save humanity from sin.
summary: Jesus Christ is the central figure of Christianity. Christians believe He is the Son of God who became human, lived a sinless life, performed miracles, taught about God's kingdom, died on the cross for the sins of humanity, and rose again on the third day.
major_points: Jesus is the Son of God
He died for the sins of the world
He rose again from the dead
